steps.description: Notice that extract.sh generates the network traffic captured in capture.pcapng (answer: capture.pcapng).
cat extract.sh to find the key used to encrypt the flag (answer: s3k@1_v3ry_w0w).

tshark -r ../../dist/capture.pcapng -Y 'http and http.request' -T fields -e json.value.string | tr -d '\n' | python3 -c "from pwn import *;from binascii import unhexlify;x=unhexlify(input().strip());print(xor(x,b's3k@1_v3ry_w0w').decode())" to recover the flag.
